text:
The development loop starts with a real failed check.
The public GitHub evidence stays linked.

A Playwright alert selector matched two messages.
The check rejected that ambiguity.

The reviewed correction targets the intended alert.
Its exact source assertion is linked here.

A later run passed the same check.
Passing alone does not prove causation.

Reusable practice: when alerts coexist,
select the intended message within its region.

Keep the failure, correction and follow-up together.
A reviewed lesson becomes context for the next attempt.
